databricks-unity:managed-offering:curren.notes: Fully managed across AWS, Azure and GCP.

databricks-unity:serves-own-irc:current.notes: Only native Unity-managed Iceberg is read and write over IRC; Delta-via-UniForm and foreign Iceberg are exposed read-only, and most Databricks tables are Delta, so only some served paths offer write.

databricks-unity:rw-foreign-irc:current.notes: One-directional: foreign Iceberg is read-only with no credential vending, and access requires a persistent base-location storage credential (a Unity external location over the tables' storage paths) plus manual REFRESH FOREIGN TABLE rather than vended credentials.

databricks-unity:federation-broker:curre.notes: Lakehouse/Catalog Federation brokers many sources but is proprietary rather than spec-compliant IRC: it requires a persistent, broadly-scoped base-location storage credential instead of the short-lived, path-scoped credentials the IRC spec vends (and Iceberg is read-only through it).

databricks-unity:multi-engine-multi-clou.notes: AWS, Azure and GCP; broad engine support inside Databricks.

databricks-unity:governance-cred-vending.notes: Strong ABAC and row/column filters within Databricks, but they are not enforced on external-engine IRC reads.
